_about: Public-domain Herbert Mortimer Luckock (1833-1909), Canon of Ely and Dean of Lichfield, for the Word Hoard: After Death and its sequel The Intermediate State, his studies of the Prayer Book and the Divine Liturgy, The Bishops in the Tower, The Church in Scotland, The History of Marriage, and his Footprints of the Son of Man and Footprints of the Apostles. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 69 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
